blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Transportation (DOTr) and the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) will work together to remove obstructions from sidewalks, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said on Tuesday. Dizon said he had sought the assistance of Public Works Secretary Giovanni “Banoy” Lopez in identifying areas where blocked walkways have become a problem. He stressed that the clearing effort would require coordination among the DOTr, DPWH, Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) and local government units (LGUs). “Because its hard…Once the sidewalk is done, it needs to be cleared from obstructions,” he said in an interview.
